entities.summary: Fot was a runemaster who flourished in mid-11th century Sweden. He is known for creating the **Rök Runestone**, a well-preserved example of Viking-age runic inscriptions. Fot's work has been extensively studied for its insights into Old Norse language and culture. The **Rök Runestone** has been dated to circa 820 CE, during the Viking Age. Fot's expertise in runic inscriptions helped establish a new field of study in medieval Scandinavia. The runestones he created have left a lasting legacy in the study of Old Norse language and literature. Fot's contributions to the field of runology are still celebrated today by scholars and enthusiasts alike.
